messages:
maria: heads up 1: we're deprecating legacy X-Auth header in the marketplace validator. want partner alignment on timeline + migration help.
kai: tentative plan? need to avoid breaking SI deployments.
partner-eng-sam: request a 90-day grace period and a small shim lib (py/js). also need a checklist for Private deployments (proxy/KMS concerns).
maria: propose: announce today, publish shims + pre-checker in 72hrs, opt-in strict validation in 30 days, hard reject in 90 days. partner office hours week 3.
kai: fine. I'll own the pre-checker and the error payloads. ops-bot open a canary job for shim verification.
ops-bot: canary created: job/partner-shim-canary-178900. CI will post results in #eng-releases. :robot_face: 
partner-eng-sam: I'll schedule partner email and collect integration owners. share the migration snippet once shims are live.
maria: thanks — will post the announcement draft here for quick review. keep replies to blockers only.
